incidents.text: Red Line Braintree Branch: Trains in both directions are operating on the southbound (Braintree Bound) track at North Quincy and Wollaston for maintenance. Riders may experience longer wait times.
Red Line Braintree Branch: Service is proceeding with residual delays of about 15 minutes.
Blue Line: Delays of about 10 minutes due to a signal problem between Maverick and Orient Heights. Trains may stand by at stations.
Orange Line: Delays of about 15 minutes due to reports of smoke near Stony Brook. Trains may stand by at stations.
